all: China Development Bank provides a €310 million EUR bridge loan to Shanghai Electric to facilitate its acquisition of 33.33% equity stake in Enemalta and 90% equity stake in D3 Power Generation Limited
AVIC International Leasing enters into a sale-and-leaseback agreement worth $136 million USD for two Maltese-flagged LNG carriers
Government of China provides RMB 35,000,000 to Government of Malta for the Chinese Garden Refurbishment and Expansion Project in 2012
China Communications Construction provides a €4 million EUR grant for feasibility study for a bridge between Malta and Gozo
Chinese Government provides RMB 6 million grant to Government of Malta for Malta Drydocks in 2002
Government of China provides RMB 5 million grant to Government of Malta in February 2009
Chinese Government provides RMB 5 million grant to Government of Malta in 2010
China donates 30 ventilators and 40,000 masks to MCFS in June 2020
Chinese Government provides RMB 3 million grant to Government of Malta for Malta Drydocks in 2004
Chinese Government provides RMB 3 million grant to Government of Malta in 2007
